fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api and the run-review-check testscript(s) covering it: two runs whose IDs share their first 8 characters each reach round 3 with a confirmed finding f1 and leave questions with different handles carrying their full IDs; with the full-ID handle already taken by an unrelated node, review-check adds review-<id>-r3-f1-2, journals that handle, a second review-check adds nothing, and the autonomous gate finds the question left for the finding.
fields.statement: rhiza run review-check names each question it leaves review-<full run ID, lower-cased>-r<round>-<finding>, so runs started in the same second never share a handle; when that handle is already taken by a node that is not this run's question for this finding, it takes the first free one (base-2, base-3, ...), journals the handle it used in the asked entry, and the run's later checks (a repeated review-check, the autonomous accept gate) find its questions by the journalled entry instead of rebuilding the handle.
